analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation six-pointer between ADO (17th) and Excelsior (15th). ADO beat Sparta 3-1 under interim Levi Schwiebbe and, according to Voetbal International, are set to bring back Maurice Steijn as coach; Excelsior have lost five league games in a row and scored none in their last two.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean lower: games between two teams in the bottom four tend to be tight, and Excelsior have not scored in two games.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners, evenly split. ADO's set-piece goals make their corners dangerous, but neither team's style changes the count; I keep it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3 cards. I lean higher: two teams near the bottom with a lot at stake, and Excelsior's Nesto Groen showed how nervy they have been with a red card inside five minutes at Twente.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots. ADO at home should take more of them, which is already in the split.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. ADO scored three against Sparta, but Excelsior have been blunt; I keep the estimate.
